name: Horizon for iPhone
subtitle: Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 rewritten in Rust, on iPhone and iPad

apps.name: Horizon
apps.subtitle: Unofficial iPhone/iPad port of Horizon
apps.localizedDescription:
An unofficial iPhone and iPad port of Horizon, Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 rewritten in Rust by Ludovic Marie and the Horizon contributors (MIT). Touch controls, an in-app launcher with instances and Horizon's mod list.

Needs your own Minecraft: Java Edition: prepare the game files with the Horizon launcher on a computer and copy them into Files › Horizon › resources. This app contains no Minecraft files.

Built-in mods (41), each by its own authors and under its own license: AppleSkin, AppleSkin, Armor Status, Astral Cruiser, The Basic HUD, BiomeCompass, Blockscope, Carry Block, ChatHeads, Classic Zoom, Coordinates HUD, Crosshair Indicator, Distant Horizons for Horizon Client, Eating Animation, Enchantment Hints, Fair Freecam, FPS Counter, Freecam, Freecam+, Freelook, MoreGamma, Fullbright, Inventory Profiles, Item New, JEI for Horizon, Keystrokes, Light Overlay, LookAt, Minimap, Mouse Tricks, Recipes, RightClickHarvest, Serverify, ShulkerPeek, SmartF3, Status Effect HUD, Toggle Sprint, TreeFall, Veinminer, X To Xray, Zoom. Full credits and licenses: Files › Horizon › Credits.

Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
